items.q: The low bone turnover entity is:
items.exp: Low bone turnover: adynamic bone disease. (Book p811)

items.q: Adynamic bone disease favours which group?
opts: Middle to elderly aged female, DM and obese
Young athletic males with high muscle mass
Children with rickets and low vitamin D
Only long-term dialysis patients of either sex
items.exp: Adynamic bone disease: middle to elderly aged female, DM, obese; prone for calcification. (Book p811)

items.q: All but one are listed under low bone turnover (adynamic). Which is the odd one out?
items.exp: Low bone turnover: middle to elderly aged female, DM, obese; prone for calcification. (Book p811)

items.q: Match the following Venn-circle element to its label — 1) Top circle  2) Right circle  3) Left circle … A) Bone abnormality  B) Biochemical changes  C) Calcification (vascular + soft tissue)
items.exp: Venn diagram: biochemical changes, bone abnormality, calcification (vascular + soft tissue). (Book p811)

items.q: In the CKD-MBD Venn diagram, calcification is limited to the vascular bed.
opts: False — it covers vascular + soft tissue
True — the soft tissue is spared
items.exp: Calcification circle: vascular + soft tissue. (Book p811)
